editorial:
Imagine being stuck on a quiet college campus during Thanksgiving break while everyone else is home with their families. That is exactly where you find Kristy, a shy student who just wants to get through her classes. Things go from boring to terrifying when she realizes she is not actually alone. A group of creepy people start messing with her head, using technology and psychological games to break her down. It feels like a nightmare where the walls are closing in, and you will feel for her as she tries to figure out who is attacking her and why they are doing it.

The acting is solid and makes the panic feel real, though the pace slows down a bit in the middle. You will love the tension, but some of the plot twists might feel a little strange. If you enjoy movies that make you feel uneasy, you should definitely give this one a shot. It is a great pick if you want something that keeps you guessing until the very end.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that Kristy was part of a cruel social experiment. The scary people chasing her were actually actors and psychologists trying to see how she would react under extreme stress. After she fights her way out and thinks she has won, she is told it was all a fake test. However, it ends on a dark note because the mental damage is already done, leaving her broken and traumatized.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and survival stories.
